case_number: 2023 INSC; CIVIL APPEAL NO(S). 277 OF 2023, CIVIL APPEAL NO. 278 OF 2023

parties.petitioner: Delhi Development Authority, Government of NCT of Delhi

summary: Locus of subsequent purchaser in land acquisition lapsing; Section 24(2) Right to Fair Compensation Act, 2013; Shiv Kumar & Anr. precedent followed; subsequent purchaser no standing to challenge acquisition; High Court erred allowing writ; Three Judge Bench authority override Two Judge Bench; acquisition lapse judgment set aside; original writ dismissed.
legal_provisions_cited: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 Section 24(2)
final_judgment: Appeals allowed; High Court judgment quashed and set aside; writ petition dismissed.
